text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's oil minister met with officials of Mitsubishi Heavy Industries to discuss progress at a $136 million urea plant which the company was building in Bahrain.
- Senior Palestinian official Farouk Kaddoumi calls for the postponement of the next Middle East and North Africa economic conference scheduled to be held in Qatar in November.
- Bahrain spent 13 million dinars last year on imported pharmaceuticals.
- U.S. Defence Secretary William Cohen is due to visit Bahrain on Monday as part of a tour in Gulf Arab states.
- The electricity and water ministry has invited bids to build three electricity projects worth 30 million dinars.
- Record turnover on the Bahrain Stock Exchange on Sunday. More than 4.7 million shares were traded.
- Bahrain's emir and prime minister praised relations with Libya after talks in Manama with the Libyan president's son.
